title: RBX process health and build identity v1
description: GET /health/details. Process liveness only; not dependency readiness, deployment authorization, release freshness or business health. Cache-Control: no-store, max-age=0. GET /healthz remains unchanged.

revision.description: Full lowercase source commit supplied explicitly at build time. Unknown or invalid input is null; never inferred from runtime environment or local Git.

builtAt.description: Validated RFC3339 UTC build timestamp, or null when unknown. Not the time of the request.

x-build-inputs.RBX_BUILD_REVISION: CI github.sha; build-only Docker ARG and Vite define literal
x-build-inputs.RBX_BUILD_BUILT_AT: UTC timestamp created by CI; build-only Docker ARG and Vite define literal

x-failure-modes.missing-or-invalid-build-input: The affected release field is null; process health remains up.
x-failure-modes.database-storage-or-feed-unavailable: Not queried or represented by this liveness endpoint.
x-failure-modes.server-unavailable: No successful response; callers must use their own timeout and report an unavailable observation.
x-failure-modes.runtime-metadata-overrides: Ignored because release identity is embedded in the built server bundle.
